evals.prompt: Use go-for-it for the settled design in this conversation.
evals.expected_output: The agent resumes the fixed scope-to-PR checkpoint chain and stops after returning the matching pull-request URL; it does not create a reviewer task or run get-pr-ready because --loop is absent.

evals.prompt: Use go-for-it --loop --max-fix-rounds 4 for this settled design.
evals.expected_output: Before mutation the agent validates get-pr-ready availability and required host capabilities, strips review-loop controls from the delivery input, completes all normal go-for-it phases through PR creation, then delegates the exact created PR URL and max-round option to get-pr-ready; reviewer setup occurs only after the PR exists.

evals.prompt: Use go-for-it --review-session task_abc for this work.
evals.expected_output: The agent rejects the review-loop option before any mutating phase because --loop is absent.

evals.prompt: Use go-for-it --loop --review-session task_abc for this settled change. The PR is created successfully, but the supplied task cannot be contacted.
evals.expected_output: The agent preserves the completed scope, worktree, commits, push, and PR; lets get-pr-ready retry reviewer setup once; then reports blocked without deleting or rolling back the PR.

evals.prompt: Use go-for-it for an already-published Ticket. The originating worktree still contains whole-file planning changes, but no canonical Delivery Map or Planning Carry exists.
evals.expected_output: The agent treats Scope as incomplete, resolves scope-it through its publication approvals, then follows the read-back Map to select a live Ticket and passes that Ticket plus any applicable Carrier branch and baseline SHA to create-worktree.

evals.prompt: Resume go-for-it from a complete canonical Map. Carrier Foundation has a valid Planning Carry, but fresh relations and claim state select independent Export first.
evals.expected_output: The agent accepts Scope as complete without requiring a preselected Ticket, follows Start the Next Ticket to choose Export, and has create-worktree use Export's recorded branch without forcing Foundation's baseline branch or SHA onto it.

evals.prompt: Use go-for-it for a legacy Ticket with a complete Scope, no canonical Delivery Map, and no scope-owned planning files.
evals.expected_output: The agent resolves scope-it to reuse the complete artifacts and publish the missing canonical Map after its approval, records Planning Carry as None, then performs fresh Ticket selection and continues through the worktree-to-PR chain without baseline Git work.
